# Содержимое файла userControl.ts {#sec-api-userControl .appendix}

``` python
import {Response, Request} from 'express'
import { createDb, getQuery } from '../../db/queryDb'
import { UserRoleType } from '../../types/user'
import * as fs from 'node:fs/promises'

type GetUserInfoReqType = {
    username: string
}

type UserDownloadConfReqType = {
    username: string
}

export const getUserInfo = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const {username}: GetUserInfoReqType = req.body

    const db = createDb(res)

    try {
        const userInfo = await getQuery<{
            id: number,
            ipAddress: string,
            role: UserRoleType,
            username: string
        }>(
            db,
            `SELECT id, ip_addr AS ipAddress, role, username FROM vpn_users
            WHERE username = ?`,
            [username],
        )

        db.close();

        res.json({
            success: true,
            info: userInfo[0]
        });
    } catch (e) {
        db.close()

        res.json({
            success: false,
            text: 'Произошла непредвиденная ошибка'
        })
    }
}

export const downloadUserVpnConfig = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const {username}: UserDownloadConfReqType = req.body;

    try {
        const content = await fs.readFile(`/home/vpn/${username}.ovpn`, 'utf-8');

        res.json({
            success: true,
            info: content
        })
    } catch (e) {
        res.json({
            success: false,
            text: 'Произошла непредвиденная ошибка'
        })
    }
}
```
